reference_status: Boîtes approximatives préexistantes du relevé assisté, non validées par un annotateur humain indépendant.

metrics_definition.top1_iou: Area of intersection divided by area of union for the highest-similarity proposal and approximate reference; range 0 to 1.
metrics_definition.best_top5_iou: Maximum IoU among the first five proposals already saved after NMS; evaluation does not reorder predictions.
metrics_definition.best_top5_rank: Original similarity rank of maximum-IoU proposal; first rank wins ties. It does not select a new prediction.
metrics_definition.top1_center_inside: Whether the center of the top similarity proposal lies in the reference rectangle, including its boundary.

limitations: Approximate references come from pre-existing assistant-assisted annotation, not an independent human benchmark.
The source control reuses the supplied query; it tests implementation, not generalization.
Only two target works are evaluated. No aggregate accuracy, historical conclusion or model ranking is justified.
Box overlap does not evaluate identity, hand contacts, narrative action or historical transmission.
Similarity scores are not probabilities and are not calibrated across methods.
Both methods use the same six height fractions, 14-pixel window grid and NMS 0.35; image and query preprocessing differ.
